author: reek
body: All fixed-point integer arithmetic (positions in pixels, velocity in 1/16 pixels) so the buffer stays i32 and matches the host exactly. No neighbour reads -- each particle sees only its own state and the two analytic wells.

author: reek
body: Two wells orbit the centre in antiphase. Angle advances with the frame.

author: reek
body: Softened attraction toward a well: acceleration component along one axis. inv falls off with distance-squared; the divide keeps it bounded near a well.
